title: Performance Scores
summary: Every ranked game now gets a 0–100 performance score with a grade, compared with players in the same role.

changes.title: Performance score
changes.description: Ranked games show a score on the match list. The match page has a Performance tab with grades for laning, farming, combat, teamfight, objectives and vision, the stats behind each, and how you did against your lane opponent.

title: Milestones and Seasons
summary: Achievements now come in three layers: permanent milestones with Bronze to Platinum tiers, a list for each ranked season, and the Current form from your latest games.

changes.title: Milestones
changes.description: Twenty-four all-time milestones such as Veteran, Pentakiller, Ward Keeper, Champion Pool and Peak Rank, each with four tiers, a progress bar, the date you reached each tier and how rare it is among tracked players.

changes.title: Season achievements
changes.description: Sixteen achievements per ranked season, from Season Grinder and Hot Streak to Role Swap, Comeback Kid and Season Peak. Earned ones stay for the season, and past seasons are kept.

changes.title: Profile highlights
changes.description: The profile overview shows your three best milestones next to your current form.

changes.title: Win rate by time
changes.description: The LP History tab has a heatmap of your ranked win rate by weekday and three-hour slot in Budapest time, with your best and worst slots, for the selected range.

title: The Big Redesign
summary: Summon.gg has a new look modelled on League of Graphs: a new profile with tabs, a full match page, Ranked 5s support, LP history and a cleaner home page.

changes.title: New profile layout
changes.description: Profiles open on a champion splash hero with rank chips and tabs for Overview, Champions, LP History and Achievements. The overview pairs a stat column (ranked cards, roles, most played) with a compact match list that expands into a mirrored 5v5 scoreboard.

changes.title: Match detail page
changes.description: Every match has its own page: scoreboard with ranks, runes, badges and bans, player comparison bars, gold, kills and CS charts, and per-player tabs for overview, fighting, farming, objectives and vision.

changes.title: Ranked 5s
changes.description: Ranked 5s ranks, LP history and games are tracked next to Solo and Flex, with their own rank card and filters.

changes.title: LP history tab
changes.description: A season-long LP chart with one point per played day and a change table grouped into collapsible days.

changes.title: Champions tab
changes.description: Per-champion stats from every stored game with mastery, plus a page per champion with its matches.

changes.title: More game modes
changes.description: ARAM Mayhem, Arena, URF variants, Brawl and other rotating modes are recognised and can be filtered.

changes.title: Large screens
changes.description: Text and icons scale up smoothly on 1440p and wider displays.

changes.title: Home, changelog and policy
changes.description: The home page shows recently searched summoners, the free rotation, the latest changes and the skins released this patch; the changelog and policy pages use the new style.

changes.title: Search as you type
changes.description: The summoner search suggests stored summoners with their rank while you type, and offers a lookup for any full Riot ID it does not know yet.

changes.title: Ranked-only achievements
changes.description: Achievements and match badges now come from Ranked Solo, Flex and 5s games only, with remakes ignored. Ties no longer hand out a badge, 5s Enjoyer replaces Normal Enjoyer, and Objective Hunter counts dragons and barons.

title: Match Cards Redesign
summary: Complete match history card redesign with sectioned layout, LP tracking, new match badges, and refined achievement system.

changes.title: New Match Card Layout
changes.description: Match history cards redesigned with a sectioned layout — Victory/Defeat result block, champion identity, KDA, items, CS/min and damage stats, all separated by vertical dividers. Cleaner, more informative at a glance.

changes.title: LP Change Tracking
changes.description: Ranked match cards now display LP gained or lost per match, calculated from LP history snapshots. Shows +/- values with color coding — green for gains, red for losses.

changes.title: Badge Overflow
changes.description: When a player earns more than 2 badges in a match, the collapsed card shows the first 2 and a +X indicator. Expand the card to see all badges.

changes.title: New Match Badges
changes.description: Added new per-match performance badges.

table.name: Solo Carry
table.requirement: Most kills + fewest deaths on the team (5+ kills)

table.name: Bad Luck
table.requirement: Best performer on the losing team

table.name: Honorable
table.requirement: MVP of the losing team (5+ K+A)

table.name: Glass Cannon
table.requirement: Most damage dealt AND most deaths

changes.title: Achievement Tuning
changes.description: Refined achievement detection windows and thresholds for better balance.

table.name: CS Machine
table.requirement: Average 8+ CS/min in 25+ min games (was single match)

table.name: Vision Pro
table.requirement: Average 60+ vision score over last 10 (was 100+ single)

table.name: Meatshield
table.requirement: Renamed from Tank to avoid confusion with role

changes.title: Match Detail Header
changes.description: Queue name, average lobby rank, and game duration now displayed in a single row on the match detail page. Unranked placeholder shown while rank data loads.

changes.title: Stats Filtering
changes.description: Overview stats (last 50 games) now exclude ARAM and Arena matches for more relevant ranked/normal statistics.

changes.title: Arena Match Support
changes.description: Full Arena (2v2v2v2v2v2v2v2) match support. Match cards show placement (1st-8th) with color coding — gold, silver, bronze for top 3, green for 4th, red for 5th-8th. Expanded dropdown shows all 8 teams in a placement leaderboard. Match detail page renders a dedicated Arena leaderboard instead of the standard team tables.

title: Achievement System
summary: Players now earn dynamic achievement badges based on their recent performance, and individual match badges highlight standout plays. Layout reworked with ranked in the header and reorganized sidebars.

changes.title: Dynamic Achievement Badges
changes.description: A new badge system that evaluates your recent matches and awards achievements in real-time. Badges are displayed on your profile between the header and match history. They update every time your profile loads, and a background cron job keeps them fresh.

changes.title: Combat Achievements
changes.description: Achievements based on in-game combat performance (last 10 matches).

changes.title: Mastery Achievements
changes.description: Achievements rewarding mechanical skill and game knowledge.

table.name: Carry
table.requirement: 50%+ of team damage in a match (last 10)

changes.title: Playstyle Achievements
changes.description: Achievements reflecting your playstyle and champion pool.

changes.title: Role Achievements
changes.description: Awarded based on your most played role across last 50 matches (30%+ required).

changes.title: Queue Enjoyer Achievements
changes.description: Achievements based on your preferred queue type (last 25 matches).

changes.title: Rank Achievements
changes.description: Based on your current ranked tier.

changes.title: Match Performance Badges
changes.description: Per-match badges awarded to standout players. Shown on collapsed match cards and in the expanded scoreboard next to each player.

table.name: MVP
table.requirement: Most kills + assists on the winning team

table.name: Solo Carry
table.requirement: Most kills + fewest deaths on the team (5+ kills)

table.name: Bad Luck
table.requirement: Best performer on the losing team

changes.title: Expandable Match Cards
changes.description: Click any match card to expand a mini scoreboard showing all 10 players with champion, rank, summoner spells, runes, items, badges, KDA, CS/min, gold, and damage. A link at the bottom takes you to the full match detail page.

changes.title: Layout Rework
changes.description: Ranked cards moved to the profile header. Left sidebar now shows Stats overview and Champion Mastery. Right sidebar has LP History, Roles, and Recently Played.

changes.title: SEO & Policy Updates
changes.description: Added robots.ts and dynamic sitemap.ts for better search engine indexing. Updated privacy policy with free-to-use disclaimer and GitHub contact link. Improved metadata with more keywords and OG image.

title: Filter & Polish
summary: Match history now supports champion filtering alongside queue type filters. Plus UI refinements across the board.

changes.title: Champion Filter in Match History
changes.description: A new dropdown next to the queue filters lets you narrow matches by champion. It auto-detects which champions you played and shows the game count for each. Both filters combine — e.g. Ranked Solo + Jinx.

changes.title: New Select Dropdown
changes.description: Replaced the native dropdown with a custom select component for a consistent look — rounded corners, smooth animations, and a scrollable list that matches the rest of the UI.

changes.title: Mastery List Links Removed
changes.description: Top Champions entries are no longer clickable links since the champion detail page isn't ready yet. Prevents navigating to a broken route.

title: Speed & Smarts
summary: Major performance upgrade — pages now load almost instantly thanks to stale-while-revalidate caching and batch queries. Plus automated LP tracking runs in the background every 5 minutes.

changes.title: Stale-While-Revalidate Caching
changes.description: All API routes now return cached data instantly from the database, even if slightly outdated. Fresh data is fetched from Riot in the background. Removed the Next.js fetch cache layer — Prisma DB is now the sole cache, simpler and more predictable.

changes.title: Automated LP Tracking
changes.description: An external cron job pings our API every 5 minutes to check ranked data for all tracked summoners. LP snapshots are saved automatically whenever LP changes — no need to have the page open.

changes.title: Dual LP History Charts
changes.description: The LP History section now shows separate charts for Solo/Duo and Flex queues. Shows "Not enough data yet" when there aren't enough snapshots. LP change indicator shows the difference between the last two snapshots.

changes.title: Live Game — Avg Lobby Rank
changes.description: The live game page now shows the average lobby rank in the header and individual rank badges next to each player's champion icon.

changes.title: Privacy & Data Policy
changes.description: Added a /policy page explaining what data we collect (all from Riot API, publicly available), how we store it, and what we don't collect. Linked from the footer.

changes.title: 10x Faster Match Loading
changes.description: Match lookups went from 50 individual DB queries to a single batch query, and new matches are now fetched 10 at a time in parallel. First-time load dropped from ~20s to ~2s.

changes.title: Live Game Polish
changes.description: Champ Select (yellow) / In Game (green) status with pulsing dot. Timer no longer shows negative values. Mobile-friendly banner with evenly spaced status, queue type, and timer.

changes.title: Mobile Layout Fixes
changes.description: Match detail header reorganized for mobile — queue name top-left, duration top-right, avg rank centered below. Team table CS column hides on small screens. Fixed sidebar spacing issues.

changes.title: SEO & Metadata
changes.description: Open Graph, Twitter cards, keywords, author info, title templates, favicons (SVG + ICO), and Apple touch icon.

changes.title: Ranked & Display Fixes
changes.description: Solo/Duo always appears above Flex. MonkeyKing displays as Wukong. Match timestamps now show granular times (5m ago, 10m ago) instead of just "Just now" for anything under an hour.

title: Database, LP Tracking & Polish
summary: Big backend upgrade today — all data is now cached in PostgreSQL for near-instant loading. Plus LP history tracking, player ranks in match details, auto-refresh, and a bunch of visual improvements.

changes.title: Prisma DB Cache Layer
changes.description: All Riot API responses are now cached in PostgreSQL via Prisma. Accounts (10min), summoner data (5min), ranked (2min), mastery (30min), and match data (forever). Second visits load almost instantly from the database.

changes.title: LP History Tracking
changes.description: Every time your ranked data is fetched and LP has changed, we save a snapshot. Over time this builds up an LP history chart on the right sidebar. The more you use the app, the more detailed it gets.

changes.title: Player Ranks in Match Details
changes.description: The match detail page now shows every player's ranked badge next to their name. Fetched via a batch API call, and the correct queue is shown — Solo rank for Solo games, Flex rank for Flex games. Unranked players get a dimmed badge.

changes.title: Average Lobby Rank
changes.description: Match headers now display the average rank of all 10 players, calculated with a point system from Iron IV (1) to Challenger (31). Shows the rank emblem and colored text.

changes.title: Auto-Refresh Timer
changes.description: The summoner page now auto-refreshes all data every 5 minutes with a visible countdown next to the summoner level. Manual refresh has a 3-minute cooldown so you don't accidentally spam the API.

changes.title: Changelog Page
changes.description: You're looking at it! A blog-style changelog where we post updates about new features and improvements.

changes.title: Champion Name Fixes
changes.description: MonkeyKing now correctly displays as Wukong, and FiddleSticks as Fiddlesticks. Also fixed the FiddleSticks champion icon returning a 403 from Data Dragon.

changes.title: Unified Type System
changes.description: Refactored the entire codebase to use Zod validators as the single source of truth for all API types. No more duplicate interfaces or unknown types floating around.

changes.title: Dark/Light Theme Toggle
changes.description: Added a theme toggle in the navbar — switch between dark and light mode. Uses next-themes with system preference support.

changes.title: Improved Splash Loading
changes.description: The full-screen loader now uses createPortal to render outside the page transition wrapper — no more flickering on page navigation. The splash stays until all core data is loaded.

changes.title: Rune & Spell Icon Sizes
changes.description: Fixed an issue where summoner spell and rune icons in the match detail table were inconsistently sized. Added fixed min-width/min-height to prevent flex compression.

changes.title: Duplicate Key Warning
changes.description: Fixed React 'duplicate key' warnings in the team table (Fragment key) and match card team icons (bot players with same puuid).

title: Launch Day
summary: Summon.gg is live! The first version includes summoner profiles, match history with detailed breakdowns, live game tracking, and a whole bunch of charts and analytics.

changes.title: Summoner Profiles
changes.description: Search any summoner by Riot ID and view their profile — ranked stats with emblem badges, top champion mastery with animated point counters, and a list of recently played teammates.

changes.title: Match History
changes.description: Browse up to 50 recent matches with a three-section card layout showing champion, KDA, items, runes, summoner spells, and team compositions. Filter by queue type (Solo, Flex, ARAM, Normal) and load more as you scroll.

changes.title: Match Detail Page
changes.description: Click any match to see the full breakdown — both team tables with expandable player stats, skill order grids, item build timelines, kill maps on Summoner's Rift, and ban displays. Every player name links to their profile.

changes.title: Charts & Analytics
changes.description: Gold advantage over time, damage dealt per player, vision score comparison, kill timeline, CS & gold progression, and a team stats face-off — all powered by Recharts.

changes.title: Objectives & Events Timeline
changes.description: Horizontal timeline bar showing dragon, baron, herald, and void grub takes with real icons. Expandable event log with kills, towers, and objectives — filterable by type.

changes.title: Live Game Detection
changes.description: If a summoner is currently in a game, a banner shows up with team compositions, bans, game mode, and a real-time timer. Champ select shows a yellow pulsing indicator, in-game shows green. Click through to a dedicated live game page.

changes.title: Champion Detail Page
changes.description: View champion-specific stats for any summoner — filtered match history, win rate, average KDA, and mastery data for that champion.

changes.title: Dark Theme with Aurora Background
changes.description: Custom dark theme with cyan and magenta accents. Animated aurora background (WebGL) with automatic fallback to a static CSS gradient for lower-end devices. GPU performance check runs on first load.

changes.title: Spotlight Search
changes.description: Click the search bar in the navbar to open a centered spotlight overlay — Mac Spotlight style. Escape to close, auto-focuses the input, locks background scroll.

changes.title: Branded Loading Experience
changes.description: Full-screen Summon.gg splash screen with pulsing dots while data loads. Shimmer skeleton animations for every component. Page transitions with framer-motion on every route change.

changes.title: Mobile Responsive
changes.description: Every page and component is optimized for mobile — match cards adapt, table columns hide on small screens, charts resize, grids collapse to single column.
